text: オーキドの　じいさんなら　いねーよ

structure.jp: オーキドの　じいさんなら
structure.en: if it's Gramps Oak you want

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a word means 'if that is what you are talking about'. じいさんなら = 'if you mean Gramps'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ねー is a rough, boyish way of saying ない, which turns a verb into 'not'. いねー = 'isn't here'.
